movelist.name: Whirlpool
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Spray Down
abilities.effect: The triggering attack’s target is knocked down to ground level, and loses all Sky or Levitate Speeds for 3 turns. During this time, they may be hit by Ground-Type Moves even if normally immune.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Burns. Defensive.
